issues.description: StockIngredient.name getter is named differently between template and solution. In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) the public getter is declared as getIngredientName(), while in the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java) it is declared as getName(). The corresponding finder methods also call different getters: template Stock.findStockIngredient(...) calls getIngredientName(), whereas solution Stock.findStockIngredient(...) calls getName(). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not prescribe exact names, so this naming divergence (getIngredientName() vs getName()) is likely to confuse students about the expected API and may produce mismatches with reference code or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose and document a single conventional getter name for the StockIngredient.name field (prefer getName()). Update the template: rename getIngredientName() to getName() (or add getName() that delegates to getIngredientName()) and update all call sites in the template (e.g., Stock.findStockIngredient). Alternatively, make the solution use getIngredientName() consistently. Also update the problem statement to explicitly state the expected getter names (e.g., getName(), getPrice(), getQuantity()) so students know the required API.
